description: Quiz & assessment sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use when the learner uploads past papers/questions ("真题", 历年试卷, 样题), wants AI to search for school-style questions, asks to be tested ("出题" "考我" "测验" "模拟题" "来套模拟卷"), submits answers for grading, or asks to review mistakes. Maintains one course-level global question bank, prioritizes uploaded questions over web-sourced material, generates MathJax-capable interactive HTML quizzes, grades answers, updates mastery, and maintains the mistake book.
